title: Less hair in the drain by week three. I was not expecting that
body: Honestly bought this purely because my scalp was constantly itchy and tight after showers. By the third week, not only did the itch completely stop, but I noticed there was significantly less hair shedding in the drain. It has made a huge difference to my wash routine.

title: Finally, a filter that doesn't kill water pressure
body: I had previously tried two other filtered shower heads that reduced my shower to a weak trickle. This one actually feels stronger than my original shower head and my hair feels noticeably softer and easier to comb through straight out of the shower.

title: My colourist asked what I changed
body: Six weeks in and my blonde highlights haven't turned brassy at all between salon visits. My scalp stopped flaking, my hair has its natural shine back, and I am pulling way less hair out of the brush. Installation took literally two minutes.

title: Colour lasts longer and scalp feels calm
body: Living in a hard water area meant my skin was perpetually parched and my hair felt straw-like. After fitting this shower head, the difference in water softness was immediate. No tight skin feeling when stepping out.

title: Essential part of my hair and scalp routine
body: Adding this filtered shower head was the first thing that actually calmed the persistent redness and flaking around my hairline. I wish I had made the switch a year earlier.

title: Two minutes, no tools. Easiest bathroom upgrade
body: Super straightforward setup. Wrapped the tape, twisted it on hand-tight, and turned on the water. No leaks, great pressure, and water feels clean and pure. Couldn't ask for better.

title: Noticeably softer water and less irritation
body: The chlorine smell in our flat's tap water used to be overwhelming. Since installing this shower filter, the water smells fresh and my skin isn't dry or irritated anymore.

title: Huge improvement for hair texture and frizz
body: My curls used to be impossible to manage because hard water minerals coated the strands. After a month with this shower head, my curls have bounce and definition back without needing heavy leave-in creams.

title: Clearer skin on my back and shoulders
body: I struggled with stubborn body breakouts for months. A dermatologist friend pointed out that municipal tap chlorine strips natural lipids and causes reactive oil overproduction. Switching to this filter cleared it up in three weeks.

title: Feels like a luxury spa shower
body: The spray face is nice and wide, giving great overhead coverage, and the water feels gentle on the face. My skin feels smooth rather than stripped when I step out.

title: Very impressed with the build and filtration
body: High-quality chrome finish that looks very sleek on my shower arm. Water pressure is fantastic. Took off one star only because the delivery took an extra day, but the shower head itself is flawless.

title: Goodbye scalp dryness and post-shower itch
body: I used to think my shampoo was causing my sensitive scalp, but it turned out to be the harsh water. Since installing this filter, my scalp is completely comfortable and hydrated.

title: Excellent water pressure and cleaner rinse
body: Was skeptical about whether a 20-stage filter would slow down the flow rate. To my surprise, the spray is crisp, powerful, and rinses out thick conditioner in seconds.

title: Noticeable difference in hair breakage
body: My hair feels so much softer and there is far less snapping when brushing post-shower. Love that the bundle came with extra replacement cartridges too.

title: Great design and high quality chrome
body: Looks premium and fits seamlessly with our bathroom fixtures. The water feels genuinely purified and soft on the skin.

title: Transformed my dry winter skin
body: Every winter my skin gets itchy, flaky, and uncomfortable. This filter has made showers feel nourishing again instead of drying. Absolute game changer.

title: Instant relief from harsh city water
body: London water was destroying my skin barrier. Fitted this in two minutes flat and felt the difference from day one. Highly recommend to anyone in hard water areas.

title: No more mineral buildup or stiff hair
body: My hair used to dry stiff and straw-like no matter what mask I used. With this filtered shower head, my hair dries soft, shiny, and frizz-free.

title: Great pressure and much cleaner water
body: Works exactly as described. Clean water, great spray coverage, and easy setup. The replacement filters make the bundle great value.

title: Best beauty investment for skin and hair
body: I spend so much on skincare serums, but fixing the water I wash my face and hair in every day made a bigger difference than any cream. Clearer skin and softer hair within two weeks.

title: Zero leaks and solid build quality
body: The included PTFE tape and seal worked perfectly on our shower arm. No dripping, solid chrome construction, and great flow.

title: Hair detangles with zero effort now
body: Rinsing with filtered water has made my fine hair so much easier to brush out after washing. Noticeably less shedding in my comb.

title: Calmed my chronic eczema flareups
body: Tap water chlorine was aggravating my eczema after every morning shower. Since switching to this 20-stage filter, my flareups have dramatically reduced.

title: My hair has its shine back
body: After moving to an older house with hard water, my hair looked dull and lifeless. This shower head restored my hair's natural softness and shine in just a couple of weeks.

title: Simple 2 minute installation
body: Literally took under 2 minutes to twist off the old one, wrap the tape, and screw this on. The water feels clean and smells crisp.
